status.unavailable: The local vault is unavailable in this environment.

setup.title: Create a local vault
setup.description: Choose a master password to protect encrypted notes, instructions, and bounded attachments on this device.
setup.warning: Development preview: encrypted local export is available, but emergency recovery and account/device binding are not. If you lose the master password, neither the vault nor an export can be recovered. Do not store irreplaceable data.

unlock.title: Unlock your local vault
unlock.description: Enter the master password. The vault starts locked after every application restart.

editor.emptyTitle: Choose an item or create one
editor.emptyDescription: Item titles and content are decrypted only while this vault is unlocked.

attachments.heading: Attachments
attachments.limit: Up to 8 files and 768 KiB of attachment content per item.
attachments.saveFirst: Save this item before adding attachments.
attachments.saveChangesFirst: Save text changes before managing attachments.
attachments.textPreview: Plain-text inspection. File type and extension are not trusted.
attachments.binaryPreview: Hexadecimal inspection. File type and extension are not trusted.
attachments.previewTruncated: The inspector shows only the beginning of this attachment.

confirm.unsavedDescription: Your current edits have not been encrypted and saved.
confirm.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the item and all of its attachments from the local vault. Storage hardware or backups may retain forensic remnants.

transfer.exportConfirmDescription: The package keeps item content encrypted but exposes structural metadata, counts, sizes, timestamps, and identifiers. Store it on protected media. Existing files are never overwritten, and this export does not add emergency recovery.
transfer.importConfirmDescription: Import is allowed only into an empty local target. An authentic older package may omit later changes. The source lineage and unavailable development recovery wrapper are preserved; no new device is registered.
transfer.importWarning: To restore instead of creating a new vault, enter the package's master password and choose an encrypted package. Import never overwrites an existing vault and may restore an older state.
transfer.lastExport: Last successful export in this app session: {{date}}. This is not freshness evidence.

phases.copying: Copying the selected package into private quarantine…
phases.authenticating: Authenticating the package and encrypted records…
